units.source_text: 经她这么一提醒，果然，不知何时，一片星星变得模糊昏花起来。

en.t: When she pointed it out like that, sure enough, at some point the mass of stars had grown blurred and dim.

units.source_text: 连起来的薄膜似的东西，在天空和沙壁的分界线上，不规则地打着旋儿，开始了毫无方向的移动。

en.t: Something like a connected thin film began to move aimlessly, swirling irregularly along the boundary line between the sky and the wall of sand.
